messages:
maria: kicking off a contrastive shadow canary for a new quantized variant. model=orca-v3a-int4-contrast, baseline=v3a-fp16. plan: 5% shadow traffic for 2h, no user-facing traffic yet. want automated fallback rules and gating thresholds. eval suite: contrast-suite-v4 + long-context stress tests. any objections? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started: id=canary-2395012345, initiated by maria, shadow=5%, duration=2h. logs: /canaries/2395012345 (bot)

aj: quick thoughts: agree with 5% shadow. propose hard gates: p95_latency <= 1.15x baseline, EM (exact match) >= 99% of baseline (i.e., <=1% absolute drop), hallucination_rate increase <= +0.5pp. auto-fallback triggers I want:
- EM drop > 1.0% AND p95_rel > 1.20 for 10m window -> immediate fallback
- hallucination_abs_increase > 0.7pp sustained 15m -> fallback
Also require slice checks (long-context and low-frequency-entity) to pass or else hold.

kai: add smoothing to avoid noise: use exponentially weighted mean over 30m for each metric, require change sustained across two independent 10m windows before auto-fallback. also include KL divergence on embeddings between baseline and variant for semantic drift (threshold: KL > 0.02).

samir: note we've seen int4 artifacts on >2k token contexts in prior runs. include an explicit long-context smoke: generate 3 samples per minute with 4k tokens, check repetition_rate and prefix-token-mismatch. if repetition_rate increases > 3pp or prefix_mismatch > 0.5% -> fail smoke immediately.

maria: good. can we express this as a single rollout config so ops can wire it to the canary-runner? putting a snippet here for review. pls comment on thresholds, especially hallucination tolerances and smoothing windows.

```
rollout:
  type: canary
  id: canary-2395012345
  baseline: v3a-fp16
  variant: v3a-int4-contrast
  traffic: 0.05
  duration: 2h
  shadow: true
  gating:
    smoothing_window: 30m
    metrics:
      - name: p95_latency
        max_relative: 1.15
      - name: em_score
        min_relative: 0.99
      - name: hallucination_rate
        max_absolute_increase: 0.005
      - name: embedding_kl
        max_absolute: 0.02
    auto_fallback_rules:
      - condition: em_drop_pct > 1.0 AND p95_relative > 1.20
        hold_for: 10m
      - condition: hallucination_absolute_increase > 0.007
        hold_for: 15m
      - condition: repetition_rate_long_context_increase > 0.03
        immediate: true
    slices:
      - long-context
      - low-frequency-entities
    post_checks:
      - name: long_context_smoke
        samples: 120
        token_length: 4000
        repetition_rate_threshold: 0.03
        prefix_mismatch_threshold: 0.005
```

aj: looks good. recommend adding a quiet-burn shadow for the first 30m where we run extra evals every 5m and only auto-fallback after 30m if rules persist. also log top 50 worst-regressed prompts to S3 for manual triage.

kai: agree. add cohort-level alerting: alert if any single cohort (e.g., spanish_nonform) shows >2% EM drop even if global metrics look ok.

canary-bot: scheduled checks: 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m, 90m. will emit summaries to #eng-ml and to /canaries/2395012345/reports. next check in ~5min.

samir: one more ask: include a baseline-compare shadow that runs top-k beam outputs through our rerank/eval pipeline — sometimes quant changes tokenization that only shows in reranked outputs. if rerank-EM delta > 1% -> escalate.

maria: thanks all — I'll update the rollout config and create the PR for the canary-runner. will include the quiet-burn 30m stage and the cohort alarms. tagging @aj for the final signoff before we let any real traffic through. :thumbsup:
